title: Scheduling and supervision
requirement: Run local workflows with visible history, bounded process trees, cancellation and recoverable effects appropriate to the actual workload.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: If jobs must survive host loss or long waits, qualify one durable scheduler against explicit effect/retry/cancellation/recovery cases and operating cost.
comparisons_on_record_where_every_named_: A recovery comparison of Dagu, Prefect and Temporal on one maintenance workload, with material deviations and unequal recovery configuration between the arms; it named no winner.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
